---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, a new source, or a new adapter for sos-beacon
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem / use case**
What are you trying to do that sos-beacon can't do today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see: a new source, AI/delivery/store adapter, config option, etc.

> **Note: the anti-slop line.** sos-beacon only ever *surfaces* pointers (a place to
> look, a score, a pick-list, a pattern-with-link). Features whose output is prose
> intended for a human to post (drafted replies, outreach copy, summaries-for-posting)
> are refused by design; see the README's refused-features list. Proposals that cross
> that line will be closed.

**Alternatives**
Anything you've tried or considered.

**Additional context**
Links, examples, or config shapes that would help.
